Control options for scree and PVE plots

Source: R/plot_controls.R
scree_plot_control.Rd

Creates a control list for the appearance of plots produced by plot.dp_scree(). The plotting function uses base R graphics.

Usage

scree_plot_control(
  title = NULL,
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = NULL,
  legend_position = "topright",
  legend_labels = NULL,
  col = NULL,
  lty = NULL,
  pch = NULL,
  lwd = 1,
  point_cex = 1,
  cex_main = 1.5,
  cex_lab = 1.2,
  cex_axis = 1.1,
  cex_legend = 1.1,
  legend_bty = "n"
)

Arguments

title

Optional plot title. If NULL, plot.dp_scree() uses "DP PVE Plot" when type = "pve" and "DP Scree Plot" when type = "scree".

xlab

Optional x-axis label. If NULL, "Component" is used.

ylab

Optional y-axis label. If NULL, "PVE" is used for PVE and "Scree Value" for scree values.

legend_position

Legend position passed to graphics::legend(). The default is "topright".

legend_labels

Optional named character vector giving legend labels. Recognized names are "nonprivate", "clipped", "pmwm", and "huber".

col

Optional named character vector of plotting colors, using the same series names as legend_labels.

lty

Optional named vector of line types, using the same series names as legend_labels.

pch

Optional named vector of point symbols, using the same series names as legend_labels.

lwd

Positive line width. The default is 1.

point_cex

Positive point-size multiplier. The default is 1.

cex_main

Positive title-size multiplier. The default is 1.5.

cex_lab

Positive axis-label-size multiplier. The default is 1.2.

cex_axis

Positive axis-text-size multiplier. The default is 1.1.

cex_legend

Positive legend-text-size multiplier. The default is 1.1.

legend_bty

Box type passed to graphics::legend(). The default "n" suppresses the legend border.

Value

A list of plotting options for plot.dp_scree().

Examples

scree_plot_control()
#> $title
#> NULL
#> 
#> $xlab
#> NULL
#> 
#> $ylab
#> NULL
#> 
#> $legend_position
#> [1] "topright"
#> 
#> $legend_labels
#> NULL
#> 
#> $col
#> NULL
#> 
#> $lty
#> NULL
#> 
#> $pch
#> NULL
#> 
#> $lwd
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $point_cex
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $cex_main
#> [1] 1.5
#> 
#> $cex_lab
#> [1] 1.2
#> 
#> $cex_axis
#> [1] 1.1
#> 
#> $cex_legend
#> [1] 1.1
#> 
#> $legend_bty
#> [1] "n"
#> 

scree_plot_control(
  title = "PVE comparison",
  legend_position = "topright",
  cex_main = 1.4
)
